summary.local: 2017년 UNIST 100% 출자로 설립된 기술사업화 전문회사. 초기창업 액셀러레이터·2025 TIPS 운영사를 거쳐 2026년 4월 VC 등록 완료, 120억원 지역펀드 운용.

strategy.thesis: Wholly-owned technology holding company of Ewha Womans University's Industry-University Cooperation Foundation; commercializes promising university technology across the IP-creation, technology-transfer and startup-launch chain.

program.location: Ewha Womans University, 52 Ewhayeodae-gil, Seodaemun-gu, Seoul

summary.en: Ewha Womans University's technology holding company, established 2016 with 100% investment from its Industry-University Cooperation Foundation. Commercializes university technology from IP creation through technology transfer and startup launch; first subsidiary Ewha E-Liner won gold at the 2019 Uni-Tech Demo Day and attracted SNU Technology Holdings investment.
